name: Dark Mode - Night Eye
description:
Enable dark mode on any website in Microsoft Edge with Night Eye.

Night Eye is a customizable dark mode extension for Microsoft Edge that transforms bright websites into comfortable dark themes while preserving readability, images and page design.

Unlike a basic color inverter, Night Eye analyzes each webpage and intelligently converts its colors to create a smooth and consistent dark mode experience.

Use Night Eye on the websites you visit every day, customize how each site looks, or let the extension automatically follow your preferred system color scheme.

DARK MODE FOR ANY WEBSITE

Some websites have their own built-in dark theme. Others remain bright or only apply dark mode to part of their interface.

Night Eye handles both.

When a website provides a supported native dark theme, Night Eye can work with it directly. When it doesn't, Night Eye converts the webpage locally to create a dark version for you.

Switch between three modes at any time:

➤ Dark — Convert the website to dark mode.

➤ Filtered — Keep the website's original colors while adjusting brightness, contrast, warmth and other visual settings.

➤ Normal — Display the website normally without dark mode conversion.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR DARK MODE

Create the dark theme that works best for your screen, environment and preferences.

Night Eye includes:

➤ Brightness adjustment
➤ Contrast adjustment
➤ Saturation adjustment
➤ Blue light / warmth adjustment
➤ Dimming
➤ Custom colors
➤ Image and icon processing
➤ Dark mode for PDFs

Settings can be applied globally or customized for individual websites.

AUTOMATIC DARK MODE

Night Eye can automatically enable or disable dark mode based on your preferences.

➤ Schedule dark mode by time
➤ Follow your operating system or browser color scheme
➤ Configure individual websites separately
➤ Apply settings based on subdomains
➤ Choose which websites should or should not use dark mode

You stay in control of when and where dark mode is applied in Microsoft Edge.

ADVANCED CONTROL

Night Eye gives you more control than a basic dark theme.

You can add custom CSS for individual websites, fine-tune how specific pages appear and create different dark mode settings for different websites.

You can also use allow and disallow lists to control exactly where Night Eye should apply Dark, Filtered or Normal mode.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN

Night Eye needs permission to read and modify webpages because changing a webpage's colors requires access to its visual content.

The webpage transformation itself is performed locally on your device.

Night Eye does not collect your browsing history or send the contents of the websites you visit to our servers for dark mode processing.

Your website preferences and visual adjustments are stored locally on your device.

Night Eye's business model is based on subscriptions, not advertising or selling browsing data.

Learn more:
https://nighteye.app/privacy-policy/

NIGHT EYE LITE AND PRO

New users can try Night Eye Pro free for 3 months, with no credit card required.

After the trial, you can choose a paid Night Eye plan or continue using Night Eye Lite for free.

Night Eye Lite lets you use dark mode on up to 5 websites of your choice. You can change those websites whenever you want.

No ads. No hidden advertising model.

Learn more:
https://nighteye.app/plans-and-pricing/

BUILT-IN SUPPORT

If a website doesn't look right in dark mode, you can contact us directly through Night Eye's built-in support system.

Night Eye is actively maintained and regularly updated to keep up with changes to websites and browsers.

WHY NIGHT EYE?

✓ Dark mode for any website
✓ Full-featured dark mode extension for Microsoft Edge
✓ Per-website and global customization
✓ Brightness, contrast and saturation controls
✓ Blue light / warmth adjustment
✓ Dimming
✓ Dark mode scheduling
✓ OS and browser color scheme integration
✓ Native dark theme integration
✓ PDF dark mode
✓ Custom CSS
✓ Website and subdomain controls
✓ Allow and disallow lists
✓ Built-in support
✓ No ads
✓ Local webpage transformation
✓ No browsing history collection for dark mode processing

Install Night Eye and bring customizable dark mode to any website you use in Microsoft Edge.
